name: Geometric Diophantine Obfuscation
description: Removes the explicit {1, 2} domain and replaces the algebraic safety condition with an unbounded domain (positive integers) and a geometric condition (triangle area). Models cannot pattern-match the bipartite structure from a small discrete set; they must formulate Heron's formula and solve the resulting Diophantine equation to discover that the only valid pairs are {1, 2}.
